new_hire_deadline_text: New employees must complete the training within 90 days of hire.
applicable_to: commercial lodging establishments with 10 or more rooms
required_topics: How human trafficking occurs in the hospitality industry
Red flags indicating potential victims of human trafficking
Procedures for identifying and reporting suspected human trafficking incidents
Role of employees in preventing human trafficking

required_content: Human trafficking information and reporting procedures

recordkeeping_requirements: Retain records of employee training completions
Records must be available for review and inspection by the Office of the Attorney General, local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies
certificate_requirements: Each employee must receive a certificate of completion from an approved training provider
The certification must include the date of the course and the title of the course
risks_or_constraints: State-controlled training requirement, may affect operational costs and employee compliance
notes: Training providers and videos are listed for reference, actual implementation details need verification from the state
